description: Hackathon-representative subset of stroke recovery check-in questions, modeled on domains common to standardized stroke recovery screens (e.g. mobility/balance, weakness/coordination, communication effects, activities-of-daily-living independence, mood, and fall history). This is NOT a validated clinical instrument -- unlike survey/hoos-jr-hip.json (the real HOOS JR instrument), this is our own representative 6-question demo set.

questions.topic: difficulty walking around your home or outside
questions.prompt_text: Over the past week, how much difficulty have you had walking around your home or outside?

questions.topic: feeling unsteady or losing your balance
questions.prompt_text: Have you felt unsteady or lost your balance while standing or walking this past week?

questions.topic: weakness or clumsiness in your arm or leg
questions.prompt_text: How much weakness or clumsiness have you noticed in your arm or leg on one side of your body?

questions.topic: difficulty finding words or being understood
questions.prompt_text: Have you had any difficulty finding words or being understood when speaking with others this past week?

questions.topic: how much help you've needed with everyday tasks
questions.prompt_text: How much help have you needed from another person with everyday tasks like dressing, bathing, or preparing food?
Have you had any falls, or any close calls where you almost fell, since we last checked in?
